target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays — Natural Purola flora records the old synonym Calylophus berlandieri subsp. pinifolius. Travis — UT herbarium index records Calylophus berlandieri var. pinifolius. Williamson — dedicated treatment documents Oenothera capillifolia subsp. capillifolia. Current Kew places these Calylophus concepts under O. capillifolia.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Exact county evidence only; historical Gaura/Calylophus names are counted only after synonym reconciliation.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the foliage and bud shape. Berlandier's sundrops has very narrow linear leaves, a low spreading perennial/subshrub habit, bright yellow 4-petaled flowers, and distinctly 4-angled/square flower buds.
diagnostic_traits: flowers generally diurnal compared with classic evening primroses

comparisons.key_distinctions: O. laciniata has much broader cut-lobed leaves. O. capillifolia is the fine-leaved yellow sundrop concept historically called Calylophus.
